miel.copy: MIEL treats Text Area as the contract for longer free-form text: the agent can configure multiline input, while the human owns audience, privacy, validation, and risk.
canDecide: Use Text Area when the value is longer than a short field and may wrap across lines.
Configure label, placeholder, helper, rows, maxLength, counter, density, and state.
Use counter when length matters for review or downstream systems.
mustAsk: The audience, privacy, retention, or review owner is unknown.
The text affects compliance, money, permissions, identity, or audit.
The experience needs rich text, mentions, templates, autosave, or comment threads.
rejectIf: The agent adds rich text behavior to the base component.
The field should be a short Input or closed-choice Select.
miel.handoff: I am using Text Area because the user needs longer free-form text. I need confirmation on audience, privacy, max length, validation, and whether richer writing behavior should become a pattern.
